API reference

Import the public API with import basco as bc. Search by name, argument or description. Public entries include exported classes and their methods. Advanced entries require a module import; internal and legacy entries are included for source reference.

How this reference is generated

Signatures, annotations and declared attributes are extracted from source without importing scientific code. Class fields are shown literally when Python generates the constructor. Documentation coverage and source version.

  • method / publicbasco.binary.parameters.EstimatedParameters.resolve
